failure_analysis.failure_analysis_summary: Extracted 5 empirical failure modes from pipeline evaluation.

failure_modes.real_example: My order arrived late and when I opened it the screen was cracked, I want a refund!
failure_modes.expected_result: Intent classified as 'product_defect_damage' or 'refund_return_request' with escalation flag for compound issue.
failure_modes.actual_result: Classifier assigned 'shipping_delay' (conf=0.52), triggering premature escalation due to low intent confidence.
failure_modes.likely_root_cause: Single-label text classifier forced to pick one intent for a compound issue containing shipping, damage, and refund signals.
failure_modes.proposed_fix: Implement multi-label intent classification and hierarchy rules prioritizing product damage over shipping delay.

failure_modes.failure_name: Low Retrieval Similarity for Novel Order Edge Cases
failure_modes.real_example: I entered my old apartment number by mistake during one-click checkout 5 minutes ago.
failure_modes.expected_result: Retrieve historical case on address correction before dispatch or auto-escalate with ACCOUNT_SPECIFIC_ACTION_REQUIRED.
failure_modes.actual_result: Top retrieved case similarity was 0.42 (below 0.65 similarity threshold), triggering NO_RELEVANT_HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE escalation.
failure_modes.likely_root_cause: Historical retrieval corpus lacks exact matches for fast one-click address changes.
failure_modes.proposed_fix: Expand knowledge base corpus with self-service address change guidelines and dense semantic embeddings.

failure_modes.failure_name: Unnecessary Escalation on Standard Self-Service Questions
failure_modes.real_example: How can I update my credit card on file?
failure_modes.expected_result: Auto-handle by providing link to self-service Account -> Payment Methods page.
failure_modes.actual_result: Escalated with code 'ACCOUNT_SPECIFIC_ACTION_REQUIRED' because key term 'credit card' triggered safety rule.
failure_modes.likely_root_cause: Escalation rule keyword matcher over-indexed on 'credit card' without distinguishing informational vs transaction execution requests.
failure_modes.proposed_fix: Refine keyword policy rules to allow auto-handling of self-service informational queries while blocking actual account mutation actions.

failure_modes.real_example: ordr #99211 non deliverd state shows rtrnd to sender pls help
failure_modes.expected_result: Classified as 'shipping_delay' and retrieved returned-to-sender historical policy.
failure_modes.actual_result: Classified as 'general_inquiry_feedback' due to uncorrected typos.
failure_modes.likely_root_cause: TF-IDF / N-gram feature representation is sensitive to word spelling corruptions.
failure_modes.proposed_fix: Add sub-word BPE tokenization or domain spell-correction pre-processing step.

failure_modes.expected_result: Promptly escalate or ask customer for order ID details.
failure_modes.likely_root_cause: Single-turn tweets lack specific issue text or order numbers.
failure_modes.proposed_fix: Maintain explicit automated follow-up prompt requesting order details before escalating.
